exposure: maternal thoracotomy under cardiopulmonary bypass for infective endocarditis (IE)
cohort: A 22-year-old pregnant woman with confirmed infective endocarditis and severe aortic valve regurgitation.
finding: A fetus can survive maternal thoracotomy under cardiopulmonary bypass with proper perioperative management, indicating this technique should not be excluded from consideration in the treatment of IE complicating pregnancy.
